nodes.description: Public payable mint() that mints sequential token ids, computes an on-chain pseudo-random gift recipient and forwards a percentage of funds to it before finalizing.
onlyOwner withdraw() that pays 10% of balance to a hardcoded address and the rest to msg.sender via low-level calls.
Public view randomNum() deriving a number from keccak256 of block.timestamp, msg.sender and caller supplied seed/salt.
View helper enumerating all token ids owned by an address.
Overridden tokenURI() with reveal switch and baseURI/baseExtension concatenation.
onlyOwner reveal() toggling the revealed flag.
onlyOwner setter for the mint price.
onlyOwner setter for the placeholder metadata URI.
onlyOwner setter for the base token URI.
onlyOwner setter for the token URI extension.
onlyOwner pause toggle for minting.
Internal view override returning the stored baseURI.
Constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and calling setBaseURI/setNotRevealedURI.
uint256 public cost = 0.025 ether; mint price checked in mint() and updatable via setCost.
uint256 public maxSupply = 5000; upper bound enforced in mint().
uint256 public headStart = block.timestamp + 10 days; timestamp-derived withdrawal gate.
bool public paused; blocks minting and toggled via pause().
bool public revealed; controls metadata exposure and set via reveal().
string baseURI used by _baseURI() and set via setBaseURI.
string public notRevealedUri returned by tokenURI before reveal.
string public baseExtension = ".json" appended to token URIs.
msg.sender: controls minting, recipient of withdraw funds, random seed and onlyOwner checks.
block.timestamp: entropy source for randomNum, headStart initialization and the withdraw time gate.
Low-level call{value:} in mint() sending giftValue to a pseudo-randomly selected owner before/while external execution.
Low-level call{value:} transfers in withdraw() (hardcoded 10% address then remaining balance to msg.sender).
Weak randomness: keccak256(block.timestamp, msg.sender, _seed, _salt) miner/caller influenceable.
_initBaseURI constructor parameter forwarded to setBaseURI.
_initNotRevealedUri constructor parameter forwarded to setNotRevealedURI.
_newCost parameter of setCost.
_notRevealedURI parameter of setNotRevealedURI.
_newBaseURI parameter of setBaseURI.
_newBaseExtension parameter of setBaseExtension.
_state parameter of pause.
tokenId parameter of tokenURI.
supply = totalSupply() inside mint().
giftAddress payable recipient of the mint gift, derived from ownerOf(randomNum(...)).
giftValue amount transferred out of the contract in mint().
success boolean returned by the low-level call in mint().
supply = totalSupply() inside withdraw().
d boolean of the hardcoded-address call in withdraw().
s boolean of the msg.sender call in withdraw().
_mod modulus parameter of randomNum.
_seed parameter mixed into the randomness hash.
_salt parameter mixed into the randomness hash.
num local holding the computed pseudo-random value.
_owner parameter of walletOfOwner.
ownerTokenCount loop bound in walletOfOwner.
tokenIds array returned by walletOfOwner.
i loop counter in walletOfOwner.

edges.reason: giftAddress depends on ownerOf(randomNum(...,msg.sender,...)) so an attacker-controlled account may become the value recipient during mint.
block.timestamp is used as the entropy seed of the keccak256 pseudo-random number.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness hash, letting the caller influence or predict the gift recipient.
withdraw depends on block.timestamp >= headStart to release funds, i.e. timestamp dependency.
headStart state variable is initialized from block.timestamp + 10 days.
mint() calls randomNum() to pick the gift recipient.
randomNum result is used to select the owner who receives a percentage of the mint value.
mint() performs an external value transfer via low-level call.
withdraw() performs external value transfers via low-level calls.
the remaining contract balance is forwarded to msg.sender inside withdraw().
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient (msg.sender) when it is a contract, enabling reentrant control transfer.
onlyOwner modifier compares owner() with _msgSender() before withdrawing funds.
onlyOwner modifier gates reveal() on msg.sender identity.
onlyOwner modifier gates pause() on msg.sender identity.
mint() requires msg.value >= cost.
mint() requires !paused.
mint() requires supply + 1 <= maxSupply.
tokenURI() returns notRevealedUri while revealed is false.
notRevealedUri is returned by tokenURI() before reveal.
_baseURI() returns the baseURI state variable.
baseExtension is concatenated into the revealed token URI.
withdraw() requires block.timestamp >= headStart.
setCost writes the cost state variable.
_newCost parameter is stored into cost.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
_newBaseURI parameter is stored into baseURI.
setNotRevealedURI writes the notRevealedUri state variable.
_notRevealedURI parameter is stored into notRevealedUri.
setBaseExtension writes the baseExtension state variable.
_newBaseExtension parameter is stored into baseExtension.
pause writes the paused state variable.
_state parameter is stored into paused.
reveal writes the revealed state variable.
constructor forwards _initBaseURI to setBaseURI.
constructor forwards _initNotRevealedUri to setNotRevealedURI.
_mod parameter bounds the modulo of the weak randomness computation.
_seed parameter is hashed into the pseudo-random value.
_salt parameter is hashed into the pseudo-random value.
num local is computed and returned by randomNum.
giftAddress is the recipient of the external value transfer in mint().
giftValue is the amount sent by the low-level call in mint().
supply local drives whether and how much a gift is paid in mint().
supply local is checked against maxSupply before withdrawing.
tokenId parameter is used to build the token URI.
_owner parameter is used for balanceOf in walletOfOwner.
ownerTokenCount local bounds the walletOfOwner loop and array size.
